brief: Single one-shot design test implementing the user's hard condition: no newly invented stroke or corrupted Chinese characters. Choose 金尊 as a two-character test label corresponding to the design task; does not assume it is approved commercial brand text.

source_provenance.purpose: 20 pinned pedagogical median centerlines as guaranteed starting semantic stroke IDs, NOT the original author-designed contours and NOT official handwriting certification.
source_provenance.source_license_requirement: Record Hanzi Writer data upstream and license in delivery; do not distribute font binary or third-party artist artwork.

arms.A: Draw all 20 indexed legitimate median stroke centerlines with a neutral handwritten path-outline algorithm. Correctly identify characters before style.
arms.B: Use exactly the same 20 indexed medians (stroke count and semantic IDs locked), but author varied entry/exit contours and a restrained coherent gesture on existing 金 top descending stroke 2 and 尊 main cross-stroke 10. No extra SVG vector fragments or disconnected ink decorations. Typography quality not inferred from stroke provenance.
arms.fairness: No image model. A/B with the same 2 glyph skeletons, scale, baseline and spacing; all changes bounded to appearance of the 20 existing stroke contours. Intentional optical stroke/ink differences are declared as a confound.

gates.stage1_data: Both glyph source median arrays count equals independently verified 8/12; capture SHA and source links. If counts wrong, fail.
gates.stage2_topology: Exactly 8 and 12 separately named stroke contours in SVG; no extra unrelated shapes, no missing required strokes. Must keep each median topology consistent, start/end near reference.
gates.stage3_ink: No disconnected 'decorative' ink components created by style algorithm. Major stroke continuity preserved, no cross-character fused new stroke.
gates.stage4_hanzi: Assistant visual glyph inspection at full, 96px, 64px. Recognizability uncertain => stop. Full correctness needs real Chinese reader; do NOT overclaim official stroke correctness from medians/ID.
gates.stage5_aesthetics: Only if both pass orthography preliminary checks, compare equal ink-size. If B looks like generic stylization or not obviously better, mark visual FAIL and don't write Figma.
gates.stage6_fidelity: Only after independent human acceptability and new-word transfer may the rule be promoted.

creative_intent: Restrained architectural upward support on existing ends of 2 original legitimate strokes; preserve all 20 content strokes. No stock font, no extra dots, no automatic raster tracing.
hard_veto: Any extra source-semantic stroke, omitted reference stroke, incorrect radical, disjoint optical artifacts, wrong or ambiguous Hanzi, simplistic default font-like result presented as creative success.
stop_condition: One A/B candidate only. If no distinct visually superior B, freeze failure and halt 'vector count' iterations. Do not create serial R30+ revisions.
